description: This file defines UI components and formatting logic for displaying nodes within a menu in a macOS application using SwiftUI. It includes structures for formatting node entries, rendering node rows in the menu, and icons for different device types.

classes.name: NodeMenuEntryFormatter
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods to format and interpret NodeInfo data for display in the node menu, including name, status, platform, versions, and icons.

classes.name: NodeMenuRowView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single row in the node menu, displaying node icon, name, status, and version info.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A SwiftUI view rendering an icon indicating an Android device.

methods.name: isGateway
methods.description: Checks if the provided NodeInfo represents a gateway node.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the provided NodeInfo node is connected.

methods.name: primaryName
methods.description: Returns the primary display name for a node, prioritizing gateway status.

methods.name: summaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string for a node, including name, IP, platform, version labels, and status.

methods.name: roleText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the connection role of the node.

methods.name: detailLeft
methods.description: Provides the left detail text for a node entry, including IP and role.

methods.name: headlineRight
methods.description: Returns platform information for display on the right side of the headline.

methods.name: detailRightVersion
methods.description: Returns version labels for display on the right side of details.

methods.name: platformText
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly platform name based on the platform or device family.

methods.name: compactVersion
methods.description: Produces a trimmed version string from raw version input, removing extra details.

methods.name: shortVersionLabel
methods.description: Generates a concise version label, adding a 'v' prefix if needed.

methods.name: versionLabels
methods.description: Returns core and UI version labels based on node info, optionally compacted.

methods.name: resolveVersions
methods.description: Resolves node version strings into core and UI versions considering legacy formats.

methods.name: isHeadlessPlatform
methods.description: Determines if a platform string indicates a headless (non-GUI) system.

methods.name: leadingSymbol
methods.description: Provides an SF Symbol name representing the device type or gateway.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Checks if the node represents an Android device.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Returns a system symbol name if available, otherwise returns a fallback name.
